title: WeaveMindAI/weft
claim: WeaveMindAI/weft — A programming language for AI orchestrations (POC)
why_good: A programming language for AI orchestration (still a POC) — an ambitious bet that agent workflows need their own language.
value: Languages monetize via a cloud/runtime around them; far off, and only if it gets real adoption.
risk: POC stage; new languages almost never achieve adoption, and orchestration is crowded with libraries, not languages.

zh.claim: WeaveMindAI/weft —— 面向 AI 编排的编程语言(POC)。
zh.why_good: 一门面向 AI 编排的编程语言(还是 POC)——一个雄心押注:agent 工作流需要自己的语言。
zh.value: 语言靠围绕它的云/运行时变现;很遥远,且只有真获得采用才行。
zh.risk: POC 阶段;新语言几乎从不成功,而编排是 库 而非 语言 在竞争。
